d: Noah Harrington's construction in Oak Creek unearths old Letters to Santa. He partners with historian Tessa Findlay to fulfill Christmas wishes, sparking an unexpected romance.

Big-city food critic Holly gets stuck in the Christmas-obsessed town of Pine Falls. In the quaint town square, she discovers the joy of community, the magic of hot chocolate, and the life-altering power of love.
Travel and lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang leaves the big city behind and visits the small town of Solvang for a Christmas vlog piece after it's voted "Most Christmassy Town in the USA."

Tiffany finally reunites with her long-time crush Brett, only to find out that he has a serious girlfriend. Tiffany hatches a plan with a recently heartbroken Peter to win back the affection of their respective soulmates.
